notes:
Original reports F(4,15) verbatim. Replication ANOVA table provides ges=.3962 and p=5.7e-26; prose rounds effect to .40 and p to .000, so table values retained.
Completion source review (n_o): Experiment 3 explicitly identifies the remaining 16 participants after exclusions from final analysis; both assigned outcomes belong to this experiment. This is the printed final participant count, not N inferred from degrees of freedom.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Printed η2 for the Experiment 3 actual contrast-level main effect, identified by the face-choice-by-contrast description; paired with its same-test p.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Exact printed p = .0001 for the same actual contrast-level main effect as η2 = .31; retain equality.
